Hi Jacob / AP team,

Congrats on the renewal — happy to be continuing the partnership. To finish the final billing and close out the current term we need a couple of confirmations from your side so our finance team can generate two final documents (pro forma invoice + true-up invoice) and route them through your preferred AP path. Can you confirm the following items by EOD next week?

- Legal business name for invoicing (exact as on TAX / TIN docs)
- Billing address for AP (postal address for invoice stamping)
- VAT/GST or TIN number for cross-border tax handling (if applicable)
- PO number to reference on both invoices (if a single PO covers committed subscription + usage true-up, let us know)
- Preferred payment method: wire (SWIFT/IBAN), ACH (US), or vendor portal (please share the vendor ID)

Attachments: we will provide a pro forma that splits committed subscription vs. usage true-up lines to align with your ledger teams — sample attached.

If you have an escrow/finance code we should include on the invoice (e.g., project code or GL string), paste it in the reply.

Thanks — I’m copying our billing ops (Monica) and collections lead (Karthik) so they can pick up once we have your details.

Best,
Mateo

Thanks — clear. Operational notes for billing ops: 

1) Split invoicing approach (recommended):

   - Invoice B (True-up / Usage): reference PO-4472 & "True-up", amount = usage delta per attached pro forma, payment terms = Immediate (we'll mark as ASAP), include GL: SAAS-USG-210.

2) Tax handling: They provided a US TIN — no VAT reverse charge required. Add a one-line tax residency statement: "Borealis Health Systems, Inc. is a U.S. taxpayer (TIN: 04-1234567) — no VAT applicable." Keep TIN masked for external PDFs (display last 4 digits: ***-***-4567) but store full TIN in our secured finance record.

3) Escrow / routing: If they need an escrow reference place it in invoice footer and use our escrow ref: RED-ESC-22.

4) Delivery: Send both invoices as separate PDFs to accounts@borealishealth.com and cc: procure@borealishealth.com. Include a CSV with line-level usage that ties to the pro forma.

Monica: can you prepare the two PDFs and the CSV? Vanessa: please confirm the GL strings and the posting date (suggest invoice date = 2028-06-11 to align with renewal effective date).

Karthik
